verdict.rationale: Batch mode documents per-file failure handling. Files are processed independently, failures surface as FILE_FAILED or FILE_SKIPPED, and unsupported extensions are skipped with the UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA error code, so one bad file is isolated rather than blocking the job. Missing for 10: a documented error-code catalog beyond UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA, retry guidance (which errors are retryable, backoff advice), explicit fail-fast or timeout behavior for corrupt files, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, failed jobs return documented error codes with retry guidance, and a bad file fails fast instead of hanging

citations.quote: unsupported extensions are skipped with the UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA error code
Per-file states include FILE_FAILED and FILE_SKIPPED
Jobs expose QUEUED, PROCESSING, SUCCEEDED, PARTIAL, FAILED, and CANCELED states
